about: Filters a list of commands as the reader types, and runs the command the reader picks. The field keeps focus, the arrow keys move the highlight, and Enter runs the highlighted command.

empty.about: A query that matches no command. `Command.Empty` takes the place of the rows, and `Command.Clear` empties the query and moves focus back to the field.
empty.title: Nothing matches

keywords.about: The query `add` matches New invoice through its keywords, which the row does not show. Matching ignores case and accents.
keywords.title: Keywords

narrowed.about: The query `invoice` keeps the three invoice rows under their heading. The disabled row remains in the list and does not run.
narrowed.title: Narrowed

palette.about: The eight palettes on the highlighted row. The palette also colours the bar's focus ring while the field has keyboard focus.
palette.title: Palettes

size.about: The three sizes, each with the first row highlighted. The size reaches the rows as well as the bar and the list's padding.
size.title: Sizes

title: Command
